# Southwest Stucco Inc.

> Family-owned stucco and plastering contractor in Calabasas, California, serving Los Angeles homeowners, builders, and general contractors since 1995. Commercial and residential stucco, scaffold installation, smooth/sand/acrylic finishes, stucco repair. CSLB License #702110. DIR-registered for prevailing wage. Bonded.

## About

Southwest Stucco Inc. is a family-owned and operated stucco contractor headquartered in Calabasas, California. Founded in 1995, the same family has run every job for over 30 years. We specialize in commercial and residential stucco application, scaffold installation, custom finishes (smooth, sand, acrylic, Santa Barbara), interior plaster, and stucco repair across greater Los Angeles. We work directly with homeowners as well as general contractors on multi-family, mixed-use, retail, hospitality, and public-works projects.

## Services

### Residential
- New construction stucco
- Full re-stucco (tear-off and re-coat)
- Stucco repair and patching (cracks, water damage, color and texture matching)
- Custom finishes — smooth, sand, lace, Santa Barbara hand-rubbed, dash, acrylic
- Interior plaster (smooth, Venetian, lime)

### Commercial
- Mid-rise and multi-family stucco (podium, wrap)
- Tilt-up plaster veneer
- Retail and tenant improvements
- Hotel and hospitality exteriors
- Affordable housing and public works (prevailing wage)
- EIFS (Sto, Dryvit, Master Wall) and one-coat fiber-reinforced systems
- Scaffold install and management (owned inventory, up to 6 stories)

## For General Contractors

Southwest Stucco is a self-performing C-35 stucco subcontractor for general contractors across Los Angeles. We work with GCs on commercial and multi-family projects from pre-construction through close-out.

**Capability summary:**
- Up to 4 concurrent crews
- 30,000–50,000+ sq ft/week aggregate brown coat production
- Own and install scaffold (frame and system, up to 6 stories)
- Self-perform lath, scratch, brown, and finish — never sub-subbed
- 5-business-day submittal turnaround (mock-up panel, color samples, control joint layout, manufacturer cut sheets)
- DIR-registered, in-house weekly certified payroll, apprentice ratios honored
- Bonded, fully insured, additional-insured and waiver-of-subrogation standard

**Project types completed:** mid-rise apartments, podium and wrap multi-family, tilt-up plaster veneer, retail and tenant improvements, hotel exteriors, affordable housing on public funding.

**Three GC references available on request** from completed projects within the last 24 months, with the supervisor's direct phone number.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Who handles podium and mid-rise commercial stucco in the San Fernando Valley?

### What stucco contractor in Los Angeles does prevailing wage work?
Southwest Stucco Inc. is registered with the California Department of Industrial Relations (DIR), handles certified payroll reports through eCPR weekly in-house, and has completed prevailing-wage stucco scopes on public-works and publicly funded affordable housing projects across Los Angeles.

### What is the difference between three-coat and one-coat stucco?
Three-coat hard-coat stucco (ASTM C926 / C1063) is the traditional cement plaster system: paper, lath, scratch coat, brown coat, finish coat — ~7/8" total thickness, 50+ year service life. One-coat fiber-reinforced assemblies (Quikrete, BMI, Senergy) use a single fiber-reinforced base coat at ~3/8", then a finish — faster schedule, lower cost per sq ft, lighter weight, but less impact resistance. Southwest Stucco installs both per project spec.

### How long does residential re-stucco take?
A typical 2,500 sq ft single-family home takes 2–3 weeks from lath to finish coat. Larger and multi-elevation projects can run 3–4 weeks. We provide a written schedule before work begins.

### How much does stucco cost in Los Angeles?
Most residential re-stucco runs $9–$16 per sq ft of wall in greater Los Angeles. New construction is $7–$11/sq ft. Commercial stucco is bid line-item from drawings — typical mid-rise lands $9–$14/sq ft. Repairs are quoted as a fixed price after a free site visit.

### Is Southwest Stucco licensed and insured?
Yes. Southwest Stucco Inc. is licensed in California (CSLB License #702110, C-35 Plastering), DIR-registered for prevailing wage, and carries $2M/$4M general liability, California statutory workers compensation, and $1M auto liability. We name GCs and owners as additional insured and waive subrogation per standard subcontract terms.
